pt.name: Power Thesaurus
pt.summary: INP: 100% Good on desktop · +210% 5★ ratings · 1+ GB memory leak fixed
pt.stackShort: React · TypeScript · SSR · React Native · GraphQL
pt.description:
Power Thesaurus is a crowdsourced online English thesaurus — an international product with ~3.1 million unique monthly users. Revenue comes from a PRO subscription and ads.

The platform spans a server-rendered web app, iOS and Android apps built with React Native, and a browser extension for all major browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge and Opera.

results.label: Good URLs in Core Web Vitals on desktop
earlier start for the main JS

pt.role: 2 years of product development in React and TypeScript across web, mobile and the extension, focused on frontend performance and quality. I own work end to end: from digging into metrics and breaking tasks down to staged rollouts and measuring the impact.
done: Core Web Vitals / INP. Set up field data collection that pinpoints slow interactions; optimized ad refresh, autocomplete, navigation (startTransition) and Sentry initialization. Result in Search Console: 100% Good URLs on desktop, 80% fewer poor URLs on mobile.
Loading and bundle. Code splitting and lazy loading, main-bundle preload (execution starts ~200 ms earlier), font subsetting, SVG 97 → 54 KB gzip, content-visibility.
Memory. Heap profiling revealed a leak in the ad-slot and iframe lifecycle — the tab no longer grows to 1+ GB. Wrote a technical report for the ad partner.

Testing. Covered critical flows with tests (auth, pagination, filters, Paddle payments) and replaced Cucumber/WebdriverIO with Playwright. A major dependency upgrade then shipped with zero production regressions.

Stability and accessibility. Cut thousands of irrelevant events from Sentry and made network-error and offline handling resilient. Keyboard navigation, ARIA and a high-contrast palette — Lighthouse Accessibility 100.
React Native. Rating prompt that picks a “safe” moment to ask — +210% 5★ ratings in 6 months. Push notifications (FCM) — +17% resubscription conversion.
Browser extension. Works in every tab and iframe without a page reload and inserts text into Gmail, Google Docs and Office Online. E2E tests on 20+ sites; passed Mozilla's review.
AI, SEO, design system. Integrated AI Suggest / PRO AI, handled technical SEO (Schema.org, llms.txt, Private Prefetch Proxy) and grew the in-house UI library.
pt.stack: React, TypeScript, SSR (Webpack, loadable-components), GraphQL (Apollo Client), React Native (Expo), Zustand, WebExtensions, Jest, Playwright, Sentry, Grafana
